meta.name: setup-pre-commit
meta.description: Set up Husky pre-commit hooks with lint-staged (Prettier), type checking, and tests in the current repo. Use when user wants to add pre-commit hooks, set up Husky, configure lint-staged, or add commit-time formatting/typechecking/testing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给项目添加提交前自动检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望在每次提交前自动运行格式检查和测试
copy.tagline_en: Add pre-commit checks to your project
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automatic formatting and testing before every commit

howto.what: 安装后，当你提交代码时，Claude 会自动设置 Husky 钩子，先对暂存文件运行 Prettier 格式化，再执行类型检查和测试，确保代码质量。
howto.when: 当你要求添加预提交钩子、设置 Husky、配置 lint-staged 或增加提交时的格式化/类型检查/测试时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这个项目加上 pre-commit 钩子。
设置 Husky 和 lint-staged，提交前自动格式化代码。
添加提交前的类型检查和测试步骤。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you commit code, Claude will set up Husky hooks to run Prettier on staged files, then type checking and tests, ensuring code quality.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add pre-commit hooks, set up Husky, configure lint-staged, or add commit-time formatting/typechecking/testing.

say_en.text: Set up pre-commit hooks for this project.
say_en.note: Claude will install Husky, lint-staged, and Prettier, and configure the hooks.

say_en.text: Configure Husky and lint-staged to auto-format code before commit.
Add type checking and tests to the pre-commit hook.
say_en.note: Claude will add typecheck and test scripts to the hook.
